data.pulse_interval: Pulse spacing between Temp Up/Down presses
data.drift_grace: Grace period before acting on an external change
data.adopt_external: Adopt external changes as the new desired state

data_description.min_temp: Lowest setpoint the thermostat cards allow (°C, 0.5 steps).
data_description.max_temp: Highest setpoint the thermostat cards allow (°C, 0.5 steps).
data_description.scan_interval: How often the portal is polled (15–600 s, default 300 s = 5 min). Commands get their own refreshes (~5 s after sending and at the end of the confirmation window), independent of this.
data_description.pulse_interval: Time between consecutive button presses; the AC misses presses sent too fast (0.5–10 s, default 5).
data_description.notifications: Login failure, controller/portal offline, unconfirmed commands.
data_description.max_retries: 0 = off. Re-sends a command that the AC did not confirm.
data_description.external_change: What to do when the wall panel, the portal or a power outage changes a room.
data_description.drift_grace: How long a change must persist, and at least 2 polls, before acting (0–3600 s). With 5-min polling, external changes are handled about 5–10 min after they happen.
data_description.adopt_external: Treat external changes as the new desired state instead of restoring.

error.min_ge_max: Minimum must be lower than maximum.

reauth_required.title: Msheireb login needs attention
reauth_required.description: The saved Msheireb portal login for {title} stopped working and automatic re-login failed. Go to Settings → Devices & services → Msheireb Smart Home and choose Reconfigure/Re-authenticate to enter your password again.
